question: All England Championships is associated with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Badminton__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• All England Open Badminton Championships:

 
 
• All England Open Badminton Championships held annually in England is the World’s oldest badminton tournament.
 
• The genesis of the tournament can be traced to an open tournament held in the English town of Guildford in 1898, the success of this tournament paved the way for All England’s inaugural edition, which was held at London’s Horticultural Halls in 1899.
 
 
 
• All England Open Badminton Championships 2023 was held in Birmingham.
 
• South Korea’s An Se Young won the women’s title beating Tokyo 2020 Olympics gold medallist Chen Yu Fei of China.
 
• Kim So-yeong and Kong Hee-yong of South Korea won the women's doubles, and Indonesian pair Fajar Alfian and Muhammad Rain Ardianto won the men's doubles.
